lessons.trigger: long-running PR with concurrent historical task sources
lessons.requiredBehavior: Reconcile fetched PR head, actual Git state, one canonical checkpoint, and exact artifacts before resuming or handing off.
lessons.failureCondition: Chat memory or a stale handoff becomes the sole authority.
lessons.repairAction: Re-read exact Git artifacts and repair the checkpoint.

lessons.trigger: large directive with many independently losable outcomes
lessons.requiredBehavior: Trace every required outcome to an implementation artifact and direct evidence; do not substitute green tests or PR readiness for delivery.
lessons.failureCondition: Any RO-01 through RO-09 is omitted, weakened, or replaced by a proxy.
lessons.repairAction: Keep the task open and implement or explicitly report the exact unmet outcome.

lessons.trigger: private human gold source is transformed into a public synthetic fixture
lessons.requiredBehavior: Preserve required causal/chronological structure while excluding identifiers, verbatim private text, exact private details, and private-derived hashes; test forward coverage and reverse unexplained additions.
lessons.failureCondition: A required reasoning challenge is lost or private material enters Git.
lessons.repairAction: Block publication, remove the leak from all new objects, and rerun privacy plus requirement coverage checks.

lessons.trigger: case-state, tracker, and evaluation architecture extension
lessons.requiredBehavior: Compose the repository's vault, incremental snapshot, path controller, UI, and audit harness; invent only the missing state/compaction/tracker remainder and name the simple baselines.
lessons.failureCondition: A parallel monolith duplicates an existing mechanism without a stated incompatibility.
lessons.repairAction: Replace duplication with an adapter or document the exact incompatible requirement.

lessons.requiredBehavior: Preserve architecture blinding, fresh-context graders, exact prompt/output hashes, controls, and historical failed-run status; changes force a new freeze/calibration.
lessons.failureCondition: Prior rationale leaks to graders, labels unblind early, or stale grades certify a changed instrument.
lessons.repairAction: Invalidate the affected run and establish a new source-bound baseline.

lessons.trigger: historical malformed grader output and strict admission contract
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep the stopped result classified as serialization failure, preserve it, never repair or retry it, and block dependent scoring.
lessons.failureCondition: Malformed output is semantically scored, silently repaired, or retroactively retried.
lessons.repairAction: Restore the stopped boundary and require a new version, hashes, and calibration.

lessons.trigger: critical repository with a large full suite
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use focused and affected tests during implementation and run the full package once at the final changed-state checkpoint, with telemetry.
lessons.failureCondition: Repeated identical-state full suites add no decision-relevant evidence.
lessons.repairAction: Return to focused tests and defer the next full run until state changes materially.
